facts.text: Grand Hyatt Macau is located within City of Dreams in the Cotai area of Macau.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Macau, one of the best Macau hotels located within City of Dreams in the Cotai area

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are in the hotel's Grand Tower or Grand Club Tower, with views over Cotai.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Macau offers 791 guestrooms and suites in the hotel’s Grand Tower or Grand Club Tower featuring spectacular views over the Cotai

facts.text: Fountain View rooms and suites offer views of the fountain.
facts.excerpt: Take in spectacular fountain views in this 52‑sq‑m contemporary guest room.

facts.text: Grand Club privileges include breakfast and evening cocktails at the Grand Club Lounge on the 37th floor of the Grand Club Tower.
facts.excerpt: enjoy exclusive Grand Club privileges, including breakfast, evening cocktails, and more, at the Grand Club Lounge on the 37th floor of the Grand Club Tower

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on level 33 and features a study room, kitchen, dining area, spa and a private gym.
facts.excerpt: Escape to this 220‑sq‑m luxury suite on level 33, where the Cotai skyline forms the backdrop, featuring a study room, kitchen, dining area, spa and a private gym

facts.text: The Premier Suite has a work space, a spacious living room and a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Escape to this chic 110‑sq‑m fountain‑view suite with a work space, a spacious living room, a luxurious bathroom and a full kitchen

facts.text: Isala Spa spreads over approximately 25,000 square feet and includes treatment rooms and suites designed for couples.
facts.excerpt: Spread over approximately 25,000 square feet (2,323 square meters), Isala Spa includes 15 treatment rooms and suites, six of which are designed for couples.

facts.text: Isala Spa has outdoor hot tubs, steam rooms and freeze showers.
facts.excerpt: Elsewhere in the spa, guests can indulge in outdoor hot tubs, steam rooms and freeze showers.

facts.text: Isala Spa has a dedicated foot massage room overlooking private landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: There is also a dedicated foot massage room overlooking private landscaped gardens.

facts.text: The hotel has a temperature-controlled outdoor pool that is open year-round.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Macau features a 40-metre, temperature-controlled outdoor pool that is open year-round.

facts.text: Lifeguards are on duty at the outdoor pool during service hours, making it a good venue for families.
facts.excerpt: Lifeguards are on duty during service hours, making this an excellent venue for families.

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious 24-hour fitness centre in Grand Hyatt Macau features free weights and the latest cardio and resistance machines

facts.text: Beijing Kitchen serves Northern Chinese cuisine, including slow-roasted duck.
facts.excerpt: Beijing Kitchen presents the authentic flavors of Northern China. Each duck is expertly seasoned and slow roasted to achieve a perfectly crispy skin

facts.text: Fountain Cafe offers daily baked pastries, light meals and an afternoon tea service.
facts.excerpt: From daily baked pastries and cakes to a menu of light meals, Asian and international cuisine, set lunch offerings and an indulgent afternoon tea service, Fountain Cafe caters to every craving

facts.text: The hotel offers a House of Dancing Water show and stay package; the aquatic show is at City of Dreams.
facts.excerpt: A magnificent new legend unfolds – only at City of Dreams.

facts.text: The hotel is near the MLRT Cotai East Station, exit A.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Macau is located near the MLRT Cotai East Station, exit A

facts.text: The hotel is about a 15-minute drive from Macau International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is about a 15-minute drive from Macau International Airport.

facts.text: The hotel provides limousine service, with a choice of a Maybach, a Mercedes-Benz S500 or a multipurpose vehicle.
facts.excerpt: Guests can choose from a Maybach, a Mercedes-Benz S500 or a multipurpose vehicle.

facts.text: The pillarless Grand Ballroom hosts weddings for up to 2,000 guests.
facts.excerpt: Plan an opulent ceremony in our pillarless Grand Ballroom that accommodates up to 2,000 guests

facts.text: Self parking is free for staying guests.
facts.excerpt:
Self Parking

Free

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as offering fabulous dining, shopping, entertainment and nightlife.
facts.excerpt: the ultimate choice for both leisure and business travelers with best luxury accommodation, fabulous dining, shopping, entertainment and nightlife

facts.text: Senado Square, Macau's urban centre, is about 3.6 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
### Senado Square

3.6 Miles away
